Privacy policyWhat is kept, where, and what it is used for ›
Records
World records ›

Countries are always recorded. Choose whether to fill in cities too.

Records in Japan ›

Prefectures are always recorded. Choose what else you want to fill in.

How it is counted ›

Levels

  • There are 10 levels. Your level comes from how many places you have been to.
  • Japan: the number of prefectures. Level 10 is all 47.
  • World: the number of countries. Level 10 is 40 countries and all six continents.
  • Going back to the same place does not raise your level. It counts once.

What counts as "been there"

  • Lived, Stayed and Day trip count. Transit does not.
  • The numbers at the top (prefectures, cities, countries) follow the same rule.
  • Stations and airports are a collection, so they count even for transit.

Colour on the map

  • A place takes the colour of its strongest record. Transit plus Stayed shows as Stayed.

Badges

  • Badges only use what you record, so a badge you can never earn is never shown.
Tags ›

Rename, merge or delete the tags you have used.

Visit types ›

Rename them or change the points.

Data sources ›
  • World map：Natural Earth
  • Railways & map of Japan：国土数値情報（国土交通省）
  • Weather：Open-Meteo
  • Exchange rates：Exchange Rate API
  • City names & population：GeoNames（CC BY 4.0）

Information last checked：

Currency, tipping, visas, customs and holidays are as of that date. Monthly average temperatures are long-term averages, not a particular year. City names and populations are from the GeoNames data downloaded on Oct 1, 2026.
